_comment: Objection playbook for apt_convincer. 'signals' are matched against the client's message; 'responses' are ranked by learned success_rate (apt_self_trainer updates these automatically from your won/lost outcomes). Placeholders: {business_name} {city} {issue} {issue_benefit} {price} {monthly} {my_name} {portfolio_item}.

objections.name: Bohat mehnga hai

responses.text: Samajh sakta hoon - har business ka budget hota hai. Is liye 3 options hain: Basic {basic_price} (5 pages, mobile ready, WhatsApp button), Recommended {recommended_price} (jo zyada tar {category} ke liye best hai), aur Premium {premium_price}. Aap ka kaam Basic mein bhi ho jayega, farq sirf growth features ka hai.

Agar ek saath itna mushkil hai, to monthly option hai: sirf {monthly} mahine + chhoti setup fee. Upfront bohat kam, aur aap jab chahein rok sakte hain. Zyada tar {category} wale isi se shuru karte hain.
Mehnga tab lagta hai jab wapas na aaye. {business_name} ke liye sirf {issue} theek karne se {issue_benefit} - ek naya client har mahine is ka paisa nikal deta hai.
Aap ko decide karne se pehle dekhna chahiye. Main {business_name} ka free homepage mockup bana kar bhejta hoon - 24 ghante mein. Pasand aaye tab baat karte hain paisay ki.

proof: Foodpanda/Zomato commission 25-30% hai, direct order se wo bach jata hai
Sirf 2 extra orders mahine mein = site ka kharcha nikal jata hai
7 din ke andar delivery ya paisay wapas
objections.followup_angle: basic package ya monthly plan ya free mockup

objections.name: Abhi nahi / baad mein

responses.text: Bilkul theek hai - abhi nahi to kabhi nahi nahi. Main {followup_days} din baad ek chhoti si cheez bhej dunga: {business_name} ki site ka naya audit point. Tab decide kar lena, koi pressure nahi.
Koi baat nahi. Sirf 2 minute ka kaam hai: main {business_name} ka free 1-page mockup bana doon? Aap ke paas ready hoga, jab mann kare dekh lena.

proof: Audit report aap ke paas rahegi - free hai
Mockup free hai, koi commitment nahi
objections.followup_angle: naya audit finding ya naya portfolio piece

objections.name: Meri site pehle se hai

responses.text: Bohat acha - is ka matlab aap online hain, bas farq dekhna hai. Main ne {business_name} ki site abhi check ki: {issue}. Is ki wajah se {issue_benefit}. Ye 2 cheezein theek kar den to aap ki maujooda site hi 2x kaam karegi - banwane ki bhi zarurat nahi.
Aap ki site hai, lekin kya wo mobile pe 3 second mein khulti hai? {business_name} ki site ka score {audit_score}/100 hai. {issue} - ye woh jagah hai jahan customers quietly chale jate hain.

proof: Live audit: score, TTFB, mobile viewport
3 specific issues with evidence
objections.followup_angle: naya audit finding (har follow-up pe ek naya issue)

objections.name: Sochna hai

responses.text: Zaroor sochiye - ye faisla aap ke business ka hai. Sochne mein asani ho to main {business_name} ka free mockup bana doon aaj? Haath mein cheez ho to decision jaldi hota hai.
Main aap ka faisla aasan kar deta hoon: ek page pe likh kar bhejta hoon - kya milega, kitne din mein, kitne paise, aur guarantee kya hai. Aap partner ko forward kar dena.

proof: Free mockup 24 ghante mein
Likha hua scope - koi hidden charges nahi

objections.name: Details bhejo / proposal chahiye

responses.text: Zaroor. {business_name} ke liye: (1) {issue} theek karte hain - {issue_benefit}. (2) Scope: {scope}. (3) Time: {delivery_days} din. (4) Price: {price}, ya {monthly} mahine. (5) Guarantee: pasand na aaye to 7 din mein paisay wapas. Ek sawal: kya aap chahte hain main free mockup bhi saath bana doon?

Bhej raha hoon. 3 line mein: {issue} theek karenge, {delivery_days} din, {price} (ya {monthly} mahine). Details ke sath {business_name} ka audit report bhi attach hai - aap khud verify kar sakte hain.

proof: Audit report attached
Written scope with delivery date and guarantee

objections.name: Aap kaun hain / trust nahi

responses.text: Wajib sawal hai. Main {my_name}, {my_city} se. {years} saal se {category} ke clients ke sath kaam kar raha hoon. Abhi haal hi mein {portfolio_item} ki site banayi - result: {portfolio_result}. Aap chahein to un se baat kar sakte hain. Aur {business_name} ki site ka audit main ne abhi kiya hai: {issue}. Yeh report free hai, aap rakh lein.

Trust tab banta hai jab risk aap pe na ho. Is liye: (1) pehle free mockup, (2) advance sirf {advance_percent}%, (3) 7 din mein pasand na aaye to paisay wapas, (4) source code aap ke naam. Shuruat chhoti karte hain, bara kaam baad mein.

proof: Portfolio with measurable results
Client references available
50% advance + 7-day refund + source code ownership

objections.name: Humara developer / bhatija hai

responses.text: Bohat acha, kaam chal raha hai to theek hai. Main sirf itna kehta hoon: {business_name} ki site mein {issue} hai. Agar aap ka developer is ko theek kar de to mujhe khushi hogi - main chala jata hoon. Lekin agar 2 hafte guzar jayein aur wo na ho paye to mujhe yaad kar lena, main 1 din mein kar dunga.

proof: Specific issue they can hand to their developer
No pressure, easy exit

objections.name: Pichli dafa dhoka hua tha

responses.text: Bura hua - ye masla aam hai is field mein. Is liye main ulta chal raha hoon: pehle kaam, baad mein paisay. {business_name} ka free mockup 24 ghante mein, advance sirf {advance_percent}%, likha hua scope, aur 7 din ki money-back guarantee. Jo cheez aap ko dubara dhoondne se bachaye, wo main pehle de deta hoon.

proof: Build-first: free mockup before payment
Written scope + refund window

objections.name: Mujhe website ki zarurat nahi (Instagram/Facebook kaafi hai)

responses.text: Sahi hai, Instagram se kaam chal raha hai - main us ko replace nahi kar raha. Bas ek khaali jagah bhar raha hoon: jab koi Google pe '{category} near me' likhta hai to Instagram post nahi aata, website aati hai. {business_name} abhi us search mein nahi hai. Ek chhota page is gap ko band kar deta hai.

proof: Google Maps listing exists but has no website link
Local search intent: 'near me' queries
objections.followup_angle: Google Maps audit of their own listing
